context: Hina shows Sho different parts of the face.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Sho — mouth, here. Point at it.
lines.style: Bright, teaching-mode voice. Quick confident attack on the first word. High, clear pitch. Light and playful, the way an eight-year-old sounds when she's being a little teacher. Warmth underneath, not trying to impress, just sharing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、口、ここ。鼻も、知ってる。
lines.en: Yeah — mouth, here. I know the nose too.
lines.style: Soft, small voice. Careful precision on the naming words, showing he's paying attention. Quiet confidence. The comfortable silence of a six-year-old who doesn't need to perform, just thinks and speaks what he knows.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Let's draw a face picture together.
lines.style: Eager bounce in the opening. Quick shift to proposal-mode, inviting. High and warm. The particular brightness of a child who's just had an idea and wants to share it. No hesitation, full forward momentum.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'm going to draw a kind face.
lines.style: Small, steady voice. Soft conviction on the word 'kind'—like he's thought about this already. No rushing. The gentle certainty of a quiet child who knows what he wants to create. Warm and deliberate.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: We can make a fun picture.
lines.style: Bright closing note. Warm, satisfied tone. Slight lift on 'fun' like she's already imagining it. Soft fadeout, wrapping up the moment. The contentment of a child who knows something good is about to happen.
